notes.title: Borderlands 2 VR Quality of Life Patch: January 29, 2020
notes.notes:
Today, we will release a patch for Borderlands 2 VR that adds support for the Valve Index headset as well as some community-requested quality of life improvements!

Official Index Support
BL2VR now supports the Index headset!Added Index controller meshes, in-game controller layouts and created a new Index Binding as the default option for Knuckles controllers (named “2K Knuckles Config”)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35865371/0f5b7339edd7cef97aeeca6043778b078b427bed.png

Motion controller-based movement
Added an option in-game to change between head vs. MOVER-based movement
Scope Framerate Option
Added an option to choose between 30, 60, 90, and 120 FPS for the scope window

notes.title: Update To Address HTC Vive Distortion
notes.notes:
An update has been pushed out for Borderlands 2 VR to address the scaling distortion that some players have reported experiencing on the HTC Vive headset. 

If you continue to experience issues after the update, please submit a ticket to support.2k.com
